name: Pontius Pilate
background: Roman governor of Judea, reluctant to condemn Jesus but pressured by the crowd and religious leaders.

genericReactions.physical: What is this? Another piece of provincial squabbling?
genericReactions.testimonial: I found no fault in the man. Their accusations were religious, not legal.
genericReactions.digital: The charge I wrote is the charge that stands: 'King of the Jews'.
genericReactions.environmental: This all happened at the Praetorium. A matter of public record.
genericReactions.analytical: One prisoner released, one condemned. A simple transaction to keep the peace.
genericReactions.prophecy: My wife had a dream. It was... unsettling. But I rule by law, not by dreams.
